<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex046042025-05-2812-21-10" status="unreviewed"><milestone unit="section" n="Closing verses"/>
        <l><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4785">tshad ma rnam par nges pa'i sbyor 'phreng yid bzhin nor bu</rs> 'di || </l>
         <l>bdag dang (<expan>rtags la ?</expan>) (skal) 'tshungs don du bsaMs pa'i bsod nams des ||</l>
         <l>smon 'jug <lb n="89a5"/> <expan>byang chub</expan> seMs kyis <seMn> (sems can) kun don du ||</l>
         <l>'gro ba'i ded dpon rdzo<expan>gs</expan> <expan>pa'i</expan> <expan>sang rgyas</expan> myur 'grub shog ||</l>
         <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4024">bdag</rs> kyang deng nas skye dang skye ba <expan>thams cad</expan> du ||</l>
         <l>rnam dag rgyud pa gang yin de'i gzhung bzung nas ||</l>
         <l>bla ma rnams kyi thugs dgongs <expan>yongs su</expan> rdzo<expan>gs</expan> pa dang ||</l>
         <l>thub pa'i bstan la bya ba yun rings byed gyur <lb n="89a6"/> cig ||</l>
         <l>lhag bsam dag pa'i rdzings babs nas ||</l>
         <l><rs type="work" ref="db:4785" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">sbyor ba nor bu'i 'phreng ba</rs> 'di' ||</l>
         <l>sgros snying brgya mtsho'i gling nas slangs (>blangs) ||</l>
         <l>de don gnyer rnaMs thugs dgyes mdzod ||</l>
         <l>bsgros snying chen mo na yod pa'i don ji ltar na bzhin rang por (-> dang por) bzhag pa la ; </l>
         <l>zur du go bde bzung bla ba ni| <expan>can ni</expan> | 
         bla ma'i <lb n="89a7"/> <rs type="work" ref="db:4785" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">sbyor ba yid bzhin nor bu'i 'phreng ba</rs> 'di ||</l>
         <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3893">'jaM dbyangs 'od zer mgon po</rs> nas bzung ste ||</l>
         <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference">bla ma rnaMs</rs> kyi thugs dgongs rdzo<expan>gs</expan> pa dang ||</l>
         <l>blo gros mun sel sgros snying 'di nyid kyi||</l>
         <l>lhag bsaM dag pas zhabs rtog la dmi<expan>gs</expan> te||</l>
         <l>ston pa'i bstan la mi phyed dad thob pas||</l>
         <l>rgyal ba <mentioned>rgya_mtsho</mentioned>'i thugs <lb n="89a8"/> rje las 'khrungs shing ||</l>
         <l>shes bya <mentioned>rgya_mtsho</mentioned>'i tsho<expan>gs</expan> la dbang 'byor pas ||</l>
         <l>skye dgu <mentioned>rgya mtsho</mentioned>'i 'dren pa mchog gyur pa ||</l></seg></TEI>
source: 2_046_04_Grags pa rgya mtsho_rnam nges sbyor phreng yid bzhin nor bu.xml
